interpretation.main: The best next evidence depends on the inferential target. Observation-process calibration best reduces worst-case joint ecology-observation ambiguity, while direct state measurement best reduces worst-case ecological ambiguity.
interpretation.repeated_sampling: More samples of the same imperfect protocol are robustly dominated in this frozen case because their outcome support overlaps every target-state alternative after the initial nondetections.
interpretation.product_implication: Evidence planning must declare whether the target is ecological-world identification, observation-world identification, or joint-world identification before ranking candidate measurements.
